 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. LeBron James and the Philadelphia 76ers will host Jalen Brunson and the defending NBA champion New York Knicks on Friday as the 2026-27 NBA regular season continues into its second week.
 Philadelphia head coach Nick Nurse has his team sitting at 4-1, coming off a 114-109 road victory over Tyrese Haliburton and the Indiana Pacers on Wednesday. James finished with a team-high 10 assists to go along with 13 points. Guard Tyrese Maxey finished with a game-high 27 points, guard Jaylen Brown scored 20 points while grabbing 10 boards, and center Joel Embiid contributed 21 points and 11 rebounds.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Knicks vs 76ers TV Channels and Live Stream Options
 Philadelphia 76ers forward LeBron James (23).John Jones-Imagn Images
 Time: 7:30 p.m. ET
 Venue: Xfinity Mobile Arena, Philadelphia
 Live stream: Amazon Prime Video, Fubo
 Fans can most readily watch for free through the Fubo app, which offers a free trial. Fans can also watch the game for free through Amazon Prime. Users can sign up for a free trial that can be canceled after seven days.
 After starting the 2026-27 NBA regular season 0-3, New York head coach Mike Brown has led the team to two straight victories, most recently defeating the Chicago Bulls 133-127 on Wednesday. Guard Brunson finished with a game-high 38 points on 13-for-25 shooting from the field, to go along with seven assists. Center Karl-Anthony Towns hauled in 13 rebounds while scoring 19 points.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Philadelphia will next head to North Carolina to face Brandon Miller and the Charlotte Hornets on Saturday, while New York will host Michael Porter Jr. and the Brooklyn Nets at Madison Square Garden on Monday.
